name: recommended indicator profile
description: Recommended fields of the World Bank indicator metadata schema (timeseries-schema.json) at each maturity level, as dotted paths, with the reason each field matters for AI-ready dissemination. Levels are cumulative. The schema itself requires only series_description.idno and series_description.name. An office can remove a field from a level, but each removal has the cost named in its reason.

fields.series_description.idno: The stable identifier every citation, API call, and cross-reference depends on (chapters 2 and 5).
fields.series_description.name: The title shown in search results and answers.
fields.series_description.definition_long: Search by meaning and answers both read this text; without it a system matches on the title alone (chapter 1).
fields.series_description.measurement_unit: A value without its unit is misread: a rate per 1,000 becomes a percentage (chapter 3).
fields.series_description.periodicity: Tells a system which periods to expect and how to compare releases.
fields.series_description.time_periods: Lets a system say whether a question about a year can be answered at all.
fields.series_description.geographic_units: Lets a system say which areas the series covers before it answers.
fields.series_description.date_last_update: Freshness: an answer should say how old the figures are (chapter 5).
fields.series_description.methodology: How the number is computed, with numerator and denominator; needed to judge comparability.
fields.series_description.universe: The population the series refers to; prevents comparison across different universes.
fields.series_description.series_break: Breaks as data, so a system does not compare across a definition change (chapter 3).
fields.series_description.limitation: Caveats a trustworthy answer must repeat (chapter 5).
fields.series_description.definition_references: A link to the full definition that an answer can cite.
fields.series_description.license: States what reuse is allowed; CC BY 4.0 is the World Bank default.
fields.series_description.citation_requirement: The citation text people and systems should use (chapter 5).
fields.series_description.keywords: The words users search with, which often differ from the title (chapter 1).
fields.series_description.topics: Topic from a published list; drives filters and browsing.
fields.series_description.aliases: Acronyms and other names the series goes by; makes mentions matchable (chapter 7) and searches hit.
fields.series_description.languages: Which languages the metadata is available in; needed for multilingual search (chapters 1 and 4).
fields.series_description.contacts: Who answers questions about the series.
fields.series_description.concepts: Links to shared vocabularies, so that systems relate the series to the same concept elsewhere (chapter 3).
fields.series_description.related_indicators: Lets an answer point to the nearest series when the question does not match exactly.
fields.series_description.api_documentation: Tells software and agents how to retrieve the values (chapter 2).
fields.series_description.links: Related pages, reports, and visualizations an answer can cite.
